captions.facebook:
FINANCIAL EDUCATION · Education edition

Interest rates and the household budget

Interest rates are the price of borrowing money.

When the rate on a variable-rate loan changes, the repayments on that loan can change too. Rate changes can also affect what banks pay on savings.

Households have different loans, savings and incomes, so a rate change does not affect everyone the same way.

Knowing which of your loans have variable rates, and when a fixed term ends, is a basic part of understanding your budget.

Learn. Understand. Stay Informed.
